port:FRONTERA:18.533333,-92.65.name: FRONTERA

A measurable share of the fishing vessels calling here were flagged high-risk by the published behavioural model (McDonald et al., PNAS 2021), which is trained on 27 observable vessel behaviours — among them AIS gaps over 12 and over 24 hours, presence on an official IUU fishing list, flag of convenience, visits to ports of convenience, and transhipment events with IUU or known forced-labour vessels.
